messages.subject: Two introductory Hierarchical Modeling workshops in early 2014
messages.subject_clean: Two introductory Hierarchical Modeling workshops in early 2014
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

I just announced on the Phidot website two introductory hierarchical modeling workshops in early 2014: see www.phidot.org/forum/viewforum.php?f=8 <http://www.phidot.org/forum/viewforum.php?f=8>

(1) Introduction to Bayesian analysis of wildlife populations using BUGS software(taught by Marc Kéry), 17–21 February 2014, Singgahsana Hotel <http://www.hspj.com.my/>, Petaling Jaya, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia; see www.phidot.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=8&t=2584&sid=5ef6d800a29829a0e9e164243729f2b9 <http://www.phidot.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=8&t=2584&sid=5ef6d800a29829a0e9e164243729f2b9>  or www.bcss.org.my/stats/BAWP_outline.htm <http://www.bcss.org.my/stats/BAWP_outline.htm>.

(2) Hierarchical Bayesian Modeling for Ecologists (taught by Marc Kéry & Gonçalo Ferraz), 24–28 March 2014, Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul, Porto Alegre, Brasil; see www.phidot.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=8&t=2585&p=8189#p8189 <http://www.phidot.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=8&t=2585&p=8189#p8189> orwww.ferrazlab.com/LabSite/Teaching.html <http://www.ferrazlab.com/LabSite/Teaching.html>.

Thanks for distributing.

Kind regards  --  Marc

______________________________________________________________

Marc Kéry
Tel. ++41 41 462 97 93
marc...@vogelwarte.ch
www.vogelwarte.ch <http://www.vogelwarte.ch/>

Swiss Ornithological Institute | Seerose 1 | CH-6204 Sempach | Switzerland
______________________________________________________________

*** Introduction to Bayesian statistical modeling: Kéry (2010), Introduction to WinBUGS for Ecologists, Academic Press; see www.mbr-pwrc.usgs.gov/pubanalysis/kerybook <http://www.mbr-pwrc.usgs.gov/pubanalysis/kerybook>
*** Book on Bayesian statistical modeling: Kéry & Schaub (2012), Bayesian Population Analysis using WinBUGS, Academic Press; seewww.vogelwarte.ch/bpa <http://www.vogelwarte.ch/bpa>
*** Upcoming workshops: http://www.phidot.org/forum/viewforum.php?f=8
